hooks.text: 有限建造槽中布置并升级塔楼、城墙、兵营和经济建筑，每个位置都影响防线完整性。
hooks.excerpt: Base Building: Construct and upgrade towers, walls, barracks, and economy structures to strengthen your defenses. Limited build slots mean every choice matters.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 建筑类型可触发自动战斗式职业协同，并叠加人类、兽人和精灵的专属阵营强化。
hooks.excerpt: Class Synergies: Combine building types to unlock powerful auto-battler-inspired class bonuses and define your playstyle. Faction Perks: Choose between Human, Orc, and Elf structures to unlock unique faction-specific upgrades and strategies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 玩家不只负责建城，还会亲自以英雄身份和军队并肩作战，用技能与站位守住战线。
hooks.excerpt: Real-Time Combat: Fight alongside your army as a powerful hero, using abilities and positioning to hold the line during chaotic battles.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 可爱且漂亮的视觉受到肯定。
美术比同类作品更讨喜。

excerpts.excerpt: i liked the art here better than Thronefall.

excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
